notes: Stories cover schema, logic, API/UI exposure, integration, and testing for explainability layer.

EVAL-F5-S1.title: Explainability Schema and Contract Definition
EVAL-F5-S1.description: Define a standardized schema for evaluation explainability including fields: signal_type, source, meaning, limitations, confidence, and supporting_links. Ensure compatibility with provider (EVAL-F1, F2) and clinical trial (EVAL-F3) outputs.

EVAL-F5-S2.title: Explainability Core Logic Builder
EVAL-F5-S2.description: Implement backend logic to transform raw evaluation signals (credentials, links, trial data) into explainable artifacts using the defined schema, including human-readable summaries and limitations.

EVAL-F5-S3.title: Facade Integration for Explainability Output
EVAL-F5-S3.description: Integrate explainability layer into evaluate_care_facade so that all evaluation responses include structured explanations alongside raw signals.

EVAL-F5-S4.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability Content
EVAL-F5-S4.description: Update chat UI message rendering to display explainability fields (source, meaning, limitations) in a clear, user-friendly format within MessageBubble.

EVAL-F5-S5.title: Explainability Test Coverage and Validation
EVAL-F5-S5.description: Create unit and integration tests to validate explainability schema compliance, correctness of generated explanations, and presence in API responses.

EVAL-F5.mitigation: Standardize schema early (S1) and enforce via tests (S5) to prevent inconsistent explanations.
